personality_one_liner: A clean, focused, and encouraging educational space that builds public speaking confidence through instant, clear feedback.

spacing.rule: Use generous iOS-native spacing padding around content. Avoid dense dashboard-style layouts unless the app is data-heavy.

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it
Use glass on sticky headers over scrolling content
Use glass for the sticky 'Mulai Latihan' primary CTA container at the bottom of the Home screen
dont's: Never apply glass to form fields or body text regions
Avoid glass everywhere; keep it restricted to elevated surfaces like headers and sticky CTAs

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the app's MFCC voice analysis capabilities and let the user select their role (Siswa/Guru).
screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image with vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse). Role selection buttons (Siswa / Guru) placed in the bottom 30% of the screen inside a glass-effect container.

screens.name: Login

states.error: Error toast or inline red text

screens.layout: Clean, single-column form with labels above inputs. Sticky submit button at bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: StudentHome
screens.purpose: Dashboard for students showing recent progress and the primary action to start a new speaking practice.

states.empty: Illustration + 'Belum ada rekaman. Mulai latihan pertamamu!'

screens.layout: Top section: Welcome message + high-level stats (e.g., average score). Middle section: horizontal scroll of 'Tips Public Speaking', followed by a vertical list of recent history. Bottom: Sticky 'Mulai Latihan' primary CTA floating over a glass background above the safe area.

screens.name: Recording
screens.purpose: Focused, minimalist screen for recording public speaking audio with real-time waveform feedback.
screens.layout: Centered massive microphone button surrounded by brandTertiary pulsing rings. Top: clear large timer (e.g., 00:00). Center: Abstract wavy visual or real waveform to indicate voice input. Bottom: Sticky 'Selesai' (Done) button.

screens.name: AnalysisResult
screens.purpose: Display detailed MFCC-based intonation and clarity scores, transcript, and AI feedback.

states.loading: Analyzing audio with MFCC algorithms... (Centered spinner with encouraging text)
states.error: Failed to analyze audio + Retry button

screens.layout: Top: Two large metric cards side-by-side (Intonasi & Kejelasan Suara). Middle: Scrollable transcript with highlighted text. Below that: A visually distinct card (brandTertiary tint) for Claude AI's narrative feedback. Bottom: MFCC waveform snapshot image.

screens.name: HistoryList
screens.purpose: Archive of past recordings with scores.
screens.layout: Vertical list of cards. Each card contains the date, a mini-waveform icon, and the two scores (Intonation & Clarity). Generous md padding between cards.

screens.name: Materials
screens.purpose: Library of public speaking tips and materials.
screens.layout: Grid of cards (2-column). Each card has a tinted icon container (brandTertiary) and a title. iOS-native spacing.

screens.name: TeacherDashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of student performances for the Guru role.
screens.layout: Hero section: Classroom image with a gradient scrim displaying total students and class average. Below: Vertical list of students, showing their name, avatar (initials fallback), and latest score. Tapping a student opens their history.

onboarding_hero.alt: Woman speaking in front of a crowd holding a microphone

recording_wave_bg.alt: Abstract blue wavy lines on a white background

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality strictly. Use generous safe-area padding and avoid dense dashboard layouts.
Implement the requested 'biru/hijau' (Teal/Emerald) theme. The primary brand color is a rich Teal (#0D9488). Avoid using default iOS blue or Material purple.

For the 'StudentHome' screen, the 'Mulai Latihan' (Start Practice) button MUST be a sticky CTA placed at the bottom, floating over the scrolling content using a glass effect container to ensure thumb reachability.

Onboarding and Teacher Dashboard use hero images. You MUST apply a vertical gradient scrim (transparent at 0%, 20% surfaceInverse at 50%, 70%+ surfaceInverse at 100%) underneath any text overlaid on these images to ensure readability.
Wire up the haptic feedbacks exactly as specified in the 'haptics' block (e.g., medium haptic when starting a recording, heavy when stopping).
Ensure all text is in Indonesian as per the problem statement (e.g., 'Siswa', 'Guru', 'Intonasi', 'Kejelasan Suara').

For the AI feedback section on 'AnalysisResult', use a distinct card with a 'brandTertiary' background to make the Claude Haiku narrative feedback feel premium and separate from the numerical MFCC scores.
Never use raw hex colors in components; always reference the color tokens provided in the design_guidelines.json.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' with capped font-weights (max 500/Medium) across the app to maintain a clean editorial feel.
